sentences.text:
Vanama Srinivasa Rao, Krishna Dist. vs The State Of A.P., Rep.
By Pp. on 5 July, 2019
Author: M. Satyanarayana Murthy

entities.text: Krishna Dist. vs The State Of A.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: M. Satyanarayana Murthy
 Honourable Sri Justice M. Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.13837 of 2014
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings, in C.C.No.1408 of 2012, on the file of the Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tiruvuru, for the offences under Section 7(i), 2(ia) (k) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, R/w Rule 55 of PFA Rules, 1955, punishable under Section 16(1-A)(i) of PFA Act, 1954.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tiruvuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Ramidi Sathyanarayana, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner raises a specific ground of non- compliance of Section 16(1-A)(i)
of PFA Act, 1954, submitted that this issue is squarely covered by the judgment of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and State of Andhra Pradesh, in Criminal Petition No.15767 of 2013, dated 28.07.2014.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor also squarely considered that this issue is already covered.

Hence, based on the statements made by both learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor, the petition is disposed of in terms of judgment in Criminal Petition No.15767 of 2013,
dated 28.07.2014.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
Registry is directed to annex the copy of the order passed in Criminal Petition No.15767 of 2013 in this order.

M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY, J Date:
05.07.2019 PGR Vanama Srinivasa Rao, Krishna Dist. vs The State Of A.P., Rep. By Pp. on 5 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144796294/
